title: Two of Ring’s latest video doorbells are a lot cheaper than usual
summary: Ring's Wired Doorbell Pro and Battery Doorbell Plus are on sale for $199.99 and $119.99 respectively, marking their second-best prices on record. Both models offer motion detection, two-way talk, and color night vision, with the wired version featuring 4K video quality.
content:
Both the battery-powered and wired models are over $50 off. | Image: Ring	

Ring’s Wired Doorbell Pro and Battery Doorbell Plus are two of the brand’s most well-rounded video doorbells, whether you’re looking for a hardwired model or one that runs on a battery. Right now, its Wired Doorbell Pro is down to $199 ($50 off) at Amazon and Best Buy, while the Battery Doorbell Plus is on sale for $119.99 ($60 off) at Amazon and Best Buy. Both deals are the second-best prices we’ve seen, just $20 shy of their Prime Day lows.
Ring Wired Doorbell Pro

Where to Buy:

 $249.99 $199.99 at Amazon
 $249.99 $199.99 at Best Buy
 $249.99 $199.99 at Ring


Ring Battery Doorbell Plus (second-gen)

Where to Buy:

 $179.99 $119.99 at Amazon (includes Indoor Cam Plus)
 $179.99 $119.99 at Best Buy
 $179.99 $119.99 at Ring

Aside from how they’re powered, the main difference between the two comes down to video quality. The Wired Doorbell Pro records sharper 4K video, and it can automatically respond to visitors with prerecorded messages. The Battery Doorbell Plus has fewer features and can capture video in slightly less sharp 2K resolution. Beyond that, the two doorbells share many of the same core features. 
Both can provide a head-to-toe view of your doorstep and support motion detection, two-way talk, and support for color night vision. If you’re willing to pay $4.99 for a monthly subscription, you also get more specific alerts for people, packages, and vehicles. Upgrading to the $19.99 Ring Pro plan, meanwhile, grants access to extra AI features like facial recognition and text-based activity summaries, all of which are free for the first month. Both also work well with Amazon Alexa, allowing you to view a live feed on a compatible Echo Show smart display and receive audible announcements when someone rings your doorbell.

title: Uber CEO brushes off reports of a Waymo break-up

content:

"Waymo is a very important partner of ours, and we continue to operate in Austin and Atlanta," Khosrowshahi said in an earnings call today. "We believe we'll continue to operate next year in those marketplaces. It's a terrific product, and the on-the-ground partnership continues to be very strong."

title: Apple’s selling refurbished MacBook Neos with a $100 discount
summary: Apple is offering refurbished MacBook Neo laptops at discounted prices, with 256GB models at $599 and 512GB versions with Touch ID at $679. The devices include a one-year warranty and target students and casual users seeking affordable computing.
content:
Apple’s MacBook Neo comes in four different colors. | Image: The Verge	

Apple’s most affordable laptop, the MacBook Neo, is available once again at its pre-price hike price. All four colors are currently discounted and available refurbished through the company, with the base 256GB model listed for $599 (usually $699 new), and the upgraded version with 512GB of storage and TouchID selling for $679 (usually $799). The laptops have a one-year manufacturer warranty, with the option to purchase an extended AppleCare plan.
MacBook Neo
Apple’s most affordable laptop, with a 13-inch display, A18 Pro chip, 8GB of RAM, and optional Touch ID fingerprint sensor. Read our review.

Where to Buy:

 $599 at Apple (256GB, Refurbished)

My colleague Antonio G. Di Benedetto reviewed the MacBook Neo, and was impressed with its performance given that it’s running on the A18 Pro – an iPhone 16 Pro processor. While power users might feel a bit limited by the 8GB of memory and relatively slow storage, the excellent screen, keyboard and speakers make this a great choice for people who primarily use browsers instead of system-intensive apps. It’s also a fantastic laptop for high school or college students.
Read our Apple MacBook Neo review.
Other deals to consider
Amazon has the Google Pixelsnap Charger on sale for $41.99 (usually $69.99), the lowest price we’ve seen yet. This Qi2 wireless charger has a detachable stand to keep your Pixel 10 series phone upright and visible while charging, and supports up to 25W of power for fast charging. It’s worth noting that older Pixel models will need to use a compatible magnet case to attach to the stand.
You can pick up a Razer Wolverine V3 Tournament Edition from Amazon for $50, half off its usual price. This wired controller packs in features that competitive gamers will appreciate for tuning in their setup, like remappable back paddles, two trigger heights, and hall effect thumbsticks. It’s compatible with PC and Xbox Series S/X over USB.

title: Sure seems like Fenix Flexin used AI music generator Treblo
summary: Treblo's new AI Music Classifier detected that Fenix Flexin's "Rubberz" was very likely generated using Treblo, confirming suspicions of AI music generation. The open-source tool claims a false positive rate under 1 in 10,000.
content:
And you thought we were done with this one… | Image: Fenix Flexin	

We were pretty sure that Fenix Flexin's "Rubberz" was made using AI, but musician Medasin was confident that it was made using Treblo specifically. Now the company and a new detection tool seem to confirm it.
On Monday, the company announced the open-source Treblo AI Music Classifier, which detects when a song was generated using Treblo, though not other AI tools. According to a blog post, it has a false positive rate of less than 1 in 10,000. That's not unimpeachable, but it's notable that the company's own Classifier determined that "Rubberz" was "very likely Treblo" with "high confidence," adding more fuel to the PR nightmare for Fenix.

title: SpaceX is barely Space and mostly X
summary: SpaceX's earnings reveal the company is primarily a telecom and compute services business, with space operations contributing only 10 percent of quarterly revenue. The analysis questions the combined branding of SpaceX and xAI operations.
content:
Privatize the profit, socialize the losses? | Image: Cath Virginia / The Verge, Getty Images	

Once, I had some questions about why SpaceX, Elon Musk's healthiest company, acquired xAI, his sickliest one. Now I have some questions about why we're calling the whole thing SpaceX.
Look, what we have here, by revenue, is primarily a telecom company and a company that rents compute, according to SpaceX's first quarterly earnings statement as a public company. The space sector of the business didn't break a billion dollars this quarter and contributed only a touch over 10 percent of the company's revenue. SpaceX remains its own biggest customer. title: Google Assistant will disappear from your phone next month

Farewell, Google Assistant art, we hardly knew ye. | Illustration by Alex Castro / The Verge	

Google Assistant's days have been numbered ever since Gemini arrived on the scene, and its time is now up. Google has announced that it will be removing access to Assistant on Android phones and tablets, along with paired devices like smartwatches or headphones, from September 4th.
The announcement came in an email apparently sent to some users, as reported by 9to5Google and shared in full on Reddit. The Verge has asked Google for confirmation that the email is accurate, and will update this story once we have it.

zh.title: Google助手将在下个月从你的手机上消失
zh.summary: 谷歌将从9月4日开始从安卓手机、平板电脑和配对设备中移除Google助手，将用户转换到Gemini。该弃用标志着在Gemini推出作为谷歌较新的AI系统后，助手时代的结束。迁移完成了谷歌远离旧助手技术的转变。

title: Pushing the limits: Infinite Machine's Olto is barely a bicycle
summary: Infinite Machine's Olto uses a scooter-like layout that makes pedaling suboptimal while still incorporating pedals for propulsion. The design pushes conventional boundaries of what constitutes a bicycle. The vehicle represents an experimental approach to personal transportation.
content: Scooter layout makes pedaling a bad experience. But it does have pedals.

zh.title: 推动极限：Infinite Machine的Olto勉强算是自行车
zh.summary: Infinite Machine的Olto采用踏板车式布局，使踏板效率不佳，但仍然整合了踏板用于动力推进。该设计突破了自行车的传统界限。该车辆代表了个人交通的一种实验性方法。

title: Saudi Aramco backs India’s Mitti Labs to make Asia’s rice farming more water-resilient
summary: Saudi Aramco is backing Mitti Labs to improve water efficiency in rice farming across Asia, addressing critical agricultural and environmental challenges. Mitti Labs plans to expand from India into the Philippines and Indonesia while growing its carbon credits and agricultural data business. The investment reflects interest from oil majors in sustainable agriculture.
content: Mitti Labs plans to expand beyond India and enter the Philippines and Indonesia while growing its carbon credits and agricultural data business.

zh.title: 沙特阿美支持印度Mitti Labs，提高亚洲水稻种植的水资源韧性
zh.summary: 沙特阿美支持Mitti Labs提高亚洲水稻种植的水效率，应对关键农业和环保挑战。Mitti Labs计划从印度扩展到菲律宾和印度尼西亚，同时发展碳信用和农业数据业务。这项投资反映了石油巨头对可持续农业的兴趣。

title: AI makes weather prediction better. Can WindBorne make it lucrative?
summary: WindBorne Systems raised $37 million in Series B funding to scale its weather balloon network and AI-powered forecasting technology. The company leverages AI advances in meteorology to build a commercially viable business model. The funding supports WindBorne's mission to improve weather prediction while demonstrating profitability.
content: WindBorne Systems has raised $37 million Series B round to scale its weather balloons and AI forecasts.

zh.title: 人工智能使天气预报更准确，WindBorne能否将其商业化？
zh.summary: WindBorne Systems在B轮融资中筹得3700万美元，用于扩展其气象气球网络和AI驱动的预报技术。该公司利用气象学中的AI进步建立商业可行的商业模式。融资支持WindBorne改进天气预报并实现盈利的使命。

title: Trump’s AI testing plan is limited and vague
summary: The Trump administration's AI cybersecurity testing framework explicitly excludes open-source models, limiting assessment to proprietary systems and raising questions about effectiveness. The voluntary guidelines state they cannot restrict open models after release, narrowing the framework's scope. The initiative stems from a June executive order requesting companies share frontier AI models with the government.
content:
The Trump administration's framework for assessing potential cybersecurity risks posed by advanced AI reportedly has no interest in testing open models. Axios reports that not only do the voluntary guidelines outright exclude open models - meaning anyone can download them and inspect their core components - but the framework explicitly says it can't be used to restrict open models after they've been released.

zh.title: 特朗普的人工智能测试计划范围受限且措辞模糊
zh.summary: 特朗普政府的人工智能网络安全测试框架明确排除了开源模型，将评估范围限制在专有系统，引发了人们对其有效性的质疑。自愿指南规定他们无法在开源模型发布后对其加以限制，进一步缩小了该框架的范围。该倡议源自6月的一项行政命令，该命令要求公司与政府共享前沿人工智能模型。

title: Wispr Flow launches a Granola-styled meeting notetaker
summary: Wispr Flow is launching a meeting notetaker that generates summaries and action items, moving into productivity software similar to tools like Granola. The new feature signals the company's expansion beyond its core offering. This follows industry trends of AI-powered meeting productivity tools gaining market traction.
content: Wispr Flow's new terms of service indicate it will introduce a notetaker that generates meeting summaries and action items.

zh.title: Wispr Flow推出Granola风格的会议记录工具
zh.summary: Wispr Flow推出了一款会议记录工具,能生成摘要和行动项,进入了类似Granola的生产力软件领域。这一新功能标志着该公司业务范围的扩展。这是业界AI驱动的会议生产力工具获得市场关注的趋势的一部分。

title: Ted Lasso returns at an important time for Apple TV
summary: Apple TV is launching a fourth season of Ted Lasso as a soft reboot, mixing familiar characters with a substantially new cast. The return comes as Apple TV aggressively expands its content slate with new hits and returning favorites. The timing is significant as Apple TV pursues a larger share of the competitive streaming market.
content:
2026 is shaping up to be an excellent year for Apple TV. Apple's streaming service has built out an impressive slate that spans returning favorites like Silo and Sugar to all-new hits including OnlyFans-inspired dramedies, terrifying comedies, and paranoid tech thrillers. But the most important release might be a feel-good sports sitcom. After what seemed like a definitive finale, Ted Lasso is back with a fourth season that doubles as a soft reboot for the show, mixing up familiar characters with a substantially new cast. zh.title: 《Ted Lasso》在Apple TV的关键时期回归
zh.summary: Apple TV推出《Ted Lasso》第四季作为软重启,融合了熟悉的角色和全新阵容。该剧的回归正值Apple TV积极扩展内容库,推出新热门剧集和经典剧集回归之际。由于Apple TV争取在竞争激烈的流媒体市场占据更大份额,这个时机尤为重要。

title: SpaceX is coming for T-Mobile, AT&T and Verizon
summary: SpaceX announced plans to build a terrestrial mobile network using spectrum purchased from EchoStar, directly competing with T-Mobile, AT&T, and Verizon. CEO Elon Musk and President Gwynne Shotwell revealed the strategy during SpaceX's first earnings call. The move signals SpaceX's intention to disrupt the wireless industry beyond its satellite internet business.
content:
SpaceX is preparing to build a terrestrial mobile network to "acquire quite a few" of the customers now subscribed to T-Mobile, AT&T, and Verizon. The message to compete head-to-head with the US carriers was delivered by SpaceX president Gwynne Shotwell and CEO Elon Musk during the Q&A section of the company's first earnings call.
"The spectrum that we purchased from EchoStar does have terrestrial components, so we definitely intend to build out the terrestrial component," said Shotwell. zh.title: SpaceX将与T-Mobile、AT&T和Verizon竞争
zh.summary: SpaceX宣布计划使用从EchoStar购买的频谱建立陆基移动网络,直接与T-Mobile、AT&T和Verizon竞争。首席执行官埃隆·马斯克和总裁格温妮·肖韦尔在SpaceX首次财报电话会议上透露了这一战略。此举标志着SpaceX意图在卫星互联网业务之外进一步扰动无线行业。
